name: Kogasaka Shino
source:
[url=/c3882]You[/url] and [url=/c3907]Chinami's[/url] aunt who takes care of them after her [url=/c37580]sister[/url] dies. She works as an picture book artist, and spends most of her time working locked up in her room.

[spoiler]She was a member of the Astronomy Club when she was in school. She is unable to have any children.[/spoiler]
